newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Foreign buying boosts Portugal Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Foreign buying boosts Portugal Telecom.

text.p: A large foreign buy order boosted Portugal Telecom's (PT) share price and trading volume, dealers said.
By 1540 GMT PT had jumped 35 escudos to 3,970 on volume of 386,216 and dealers said half a million shares might change hands by the end of the session.
"The big order was arranged by an international broker and we are executing it. We don't know why there was this sudden interest," said one dealer.
Other traders said the operation might have resulted from a rearrangment in investor portfolios for the end of the month.
